facts.text: I am working on a 10-minute comedy set.
I recently took a comedy writing workshop at a local comedy club.
I am interested in writing observational humor.
I have been noticing weird things about online dating.
I have noticed that people use old photos in online dating.
I have noticed that people pretend to be outdoorsy in online dating.
I have noticed that people are actually couch potatoes despite pretending to be outdoorsy in online dating.
I had a great experience at the comedy writing workshop I mentioned earlier.
At the workshop, we did exercises that helped me think about structuring a joke.
At the workshop, I was able to get feedback from the instructor on my writing.
I have been noticing weird things about my job as a software engineer.
I have been thinking about how software engineers use jargon to sound smart.
I have caught myself using the terms "synergy" and "disrupt" in meetings.
I have been thinking about how we use jargon to sound smart in meetings.
I have noticed that sometimes we use jargon to hide the fact that we do not actually know what we are talking about.
I have been thinking about how software industry jargon is used to fit in with the "cool kids" in tech.
I have caught myself saying "I'm going to pivot our strategy" because I heard someone else say it in a meeting.
